title: Lech’s multiplicity conjecture

result.label: Lech’s multiplicity conjecture
result.statement: Proves e(R) e(S) for every flat local homomorphism of nonzero Noetherian local rings, where e is Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity. This resolves Lech's conjecture in every dimension and characteristic.
